data.name: Pioneer
data.detailed_description:
Dear Pioneers, welcome to Ward Island! *Outer Wilds* is now available! Island owners are welcome to invite their friends to explore the world together!

*Outer Wilds* is a uniquely styled and vibrant low-poly open-world survival game. You can embark on your journey alone or with friends to explore this vast world fraught with danger and opportunity. Your goal is clear: explore, survive, and uncover the ultimate mystery behind the world!

Ready for your survival adventure? Welcome to join our official community group: 1059936020

Key Features

Your world, your rules!

Here, there's no fixed path to victory. Up to 6-player co-op with friends is supported. How you play is entirely up to your mood and creativity.

Start with a unique character, build your character from scratch!

Want to play as a survivor with mischievous beady eyes, a slicked-back hairstyle, and a triangular mustache? No problem! The robust character creation system lets you define your unique appearance from the ground up.

Rise from the Ruins

Will you find existing buildings, modify them slightly, and use them as temporary shelters? Or will you become a construction maniac, building your dream base from scratch, brick by brick, for yourself and your companions? The choice is yours.

Survival is paramount.

Consciously monitoring your hunger and thirst levels is no joke. You'll need to hunt, fish, and even cultivate a farm like a true wilderness survival expert to achieve "food freedom" and ensure you don't starve before you even begin…

The scavenging never ends, and the fun is endless.

This world is scattered with hundreds of unique collectibles, from ordinary wood and stone to precious scrap metal and all sorts of firearms. You can be a happy "junk collector," selling your finds to merchants for your desired equipment, or you can meticulously collect them and show off your loot wall to your friends.

Build your own arsenal.

In this perilous world, you can't survive without a good weapon! Whether you prefer a shotgun for close-quarters combat or a precision rifle for long-range bursts, you can find your ideal choice in ruins, outposts, or from merchants. Customize your weapon with attachments to suit your fighting style, making it a true survival tool. After all, the right firearm isn't just about safety, but also about the confidence to explore the unknown!

The Ultimate Battle of Hunger and Thirst

Don't forget, your character isn't made of iron! Hunger and thirst bars will constantly remind you: it's time to eat and drink! Whether hunting game, gathering berries, or cooking a barbecue, always pay attention to your physical condition. Ignoring these indicators can lead to weakness, slowdowns, and even death—here, "you need to be well-fed to have the energy to work" is absolutely true!

Speed ​​and Passion in the Wasteland

Tired of exploring the world on foot? Try scavenging a beat-up car in an abandoned factory or by the roadside! Collect parts to repair the engine yourself, or have a merchant customize your own vehicle, from off-road vehicles to armored trucks. While speeding across the open plains, don't forget to honk your horn to remind your teammates: "Get in the car, we need to scavenge the next outpost!"

From "Newbie" to "Self-Sufficient" Farming Master

Want to achieve food freedom? Become a wasteland farmer! Collect wood and metal to build planting troughs, plant wheat, tomatoes, and even healing herbs. Watching your crops grow day by day, you'll marvel: farming in the apocalypse can be so therapeutic! Don't forget to expand your farm—after all, who can resist a hot loaf of bread?

Nature's Gifts

Hunting: Track wild animal tracks and hunt for hides and meat with bows and arrows or guns. Deer hides can be used to make warm coats, wolf meat can be roasted into steaks, and even mutated creatures may drop rare materials—but be careful, don't become their dinner!

Fishing: Take your fishing rod and cast your line at the lake! The game's fishing system is simple yet fun; timing the bite is key.

The fish you catch not only fill your stomach, but rare species can also be sold to merchants for some extra cash!

Survival Challenges in a Dynamic World

Day and Night Cycles: The ruins may be peaceful during the day, but as night falls, the dangers lurking in the darkness multiply. Torches, night vision goggles, or hiding in a fortified base—without thorough preparation, you might encounter a "surprise" under the moonlight.

Climate Cycles: Scorching sun, torrential rain, sandstorms… the weather not only affects visibility but also alters body temperature! In the desert, wear light clothing to prevent heatstroke, while on the snowfield, wrap yourself up tightly in a thick coat to avoid frostbite. Adapting your equipment flexibly is the mark of a true survival master!

This world has collapsed, order has vanished, and infected areas are scattered like sores everywhere. Here, survival is no longer an instinct, but an ultimate challenge that must be faced with full effort every day.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7600k Processor / AMD Ryzen™ 5 1600X Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or AMD Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Be able to make sounds
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64 bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-8400 Processor / AMD Ryzen™ 5 3600X Processor
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER or AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Be able to make sounds
  • VR Support: Not supported
